name: Birdgirl Dating Sim
source:
Tests, homework, and clubs are already hard enough to manage, but what if your first crush in high school was..........a bird?? 

Meet five cute girls who are not only your classmates, but also lead some quirky, feathery daily lives. From packing worms in your lunch box to eyeing up your shiny personal belongings, these cuties are as much bird as they are girl. 

Can you understand the feelings of bird girls well enough to see past the species difference and start something more?
